import numpy as np, json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
from scipy import ndimage
H=1024
src=open('/Users/manishkumar/Downloads/LAWNIX_logo.ai','rb').read().decode('latin-1').splitlines()
def bez(p0,p1,p2,p3,n=16):
    return [tuple(((1-t)**3)*np.array(p0)+3*((1-t)**2)*t*np.array(p1)+3*(1-t)*t*t*np.array(p2)+t**3*np.array(p3)) for t in np.linspace(0,1,n)[1:]]
shapes=[];cur=[];sub=None;pt=None
for ln in src:
    t=ln.split()
    if not t: continue
    op=t[-1]
    try:
        if op=='m':
            if sub: cur.append(sub)
            pt=(float(t[0]),H-float(t[1])); sub=[pt]
        elif op=='L': pt=(float(t[0]),H-float(t[1])); sub.append(pt)
        elif op=='C':
            v=list(map(float,t[:6])); p1=(v[0],H-v[1]);p2=(v[2],H-v[3]);p3=(v[4],H-v[5]); sub+=bez(pt,p1,p2,p3); pt=p3
        elif op=='f':
            if sub: cur.append(sub)
            shapes.append(cur);cur=[];sub=None
    except: pass
sh=shapes[3]  # index 3 in full list == shape #3 after dropping background
m=np.zeros((1024,1536),bool)
for s in sh:
    tmp=Image.new('1',(1536,1024),0); ImageDraw.Draw(tmp).polygon(s,fill=1); m^=np.asarray(tmp)
ref=np.asarray(Image.open('original.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
r,g,b=ref[...,0],ref[...,1],ref[...,2]
lime=(g>120)&(r<215)&(b<120)&(g-b>70)
lm=ndimage.binary_dilation(m&lime, iterations=2)
lab,n=ndimage.label(lm); sizes=ndimage.sum(lm,lab,range(1,n+1))
keep=np.isin(lab, [i+1 for i,s in enumerate(sizes) if s>200])
ys,xs=np.where(keep)
print('lime px in shape3:', (m&lime).sum(), 'components kept', (sizes>200).sum(), 'bbox', xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max())
pts=np.c_[xs,ys]; hull=ConvexHull(pts); poly=pts[hull.vertices]
json.dump(poly.tolist(), open('grass_clip.json','w'))
print('hull pts', len(poly))
EOF","exitCode":0,"success":true}
